Islet turns a stock Windows 11 desktop into a glass setup in five quick steps. It's by [Mohammed Anas Asif](https://github.com/MohammedAnasAsif).

## Download

- **`Islet-Setup-…-x64.exe`**: installer, per-user, no admin needed
- **`Islet-…-win-x64-portable.zip`**: portable, nothing installed; unzip it and run `Islet.exe`

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## What's in it

- **Island:** a glass pill at the top of the screen with music (any player), calendar, focus timer, weather, CPU/GPU/RAM and quick actions
- **Taskbar:** float your real Windows taskbar, or swap it for the Islet glass dock
- **Live wallpaper:** Silk, Aurora, Ember and Lagoon scenes, or your own videos, GIFs and pictures, behind your desktop icons
- **Widgets:** a big clock, weather, system stats, a calendar and now playing, on frosted glass
- **Glass styles:** 10 surfaces, corner roundness, and an accent colour that can follow your album art

No Rainmeter, no registry edits, no telemetry. Everything is undone when you quit, and `Islet.exe --restore` puts the taskbar back if it's ever needed.

This is the first release, so please report anything that looks off in [Issues](https://github.com/MohammedAnasAsif/Islet/issues) and include your Windows build from `winver`.
